set_translations (table)
- id: INTEGER NOT NULL
- language: TEXT
- setCode: TEXT
- translation: TEXT
PRIMARY KEY (id)
FOREIGN KEY (setCode) REFERENCES sets (code)

arguments.sql:
SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS translation_rows,
    COUNT(DISTINCT t.setCode) AS referenced_sets,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN TRIM(t.translation) <> '' THEN t.setCode END) AS named_sets,
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT t.language) AS languages,
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.type) FROM main.sets AS s) AS set_types,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM main.sets AS s WHERE s.totalSetSize IS NULL) AS missing_sizes
FROM main.set_translations AS t;

arguments.sql:
WITH translated_sets AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT t.setCode
    FROM main.set_translations AS t
    WHERE TRIM(t.translation) <> ''
)
SELECT
    s.type AS set_type,
    COUNT(t.setCode) AS translated_set_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.setCode IS NOT NULL THEN s.totalSetSize ELSE 0 END) AS total_cards
FROM main.sets AS s
LEFT JOIN translated_sets AS t ON t.setCode = s.code
GROUP BY s.type
ORDER BY s.type
LIMIT -1
